decision: Select the DOJ Special Litigation Section law-enforcement source inventory as the first active pilot.
why_this_pilot: official public source carriers with linked documents
high value for consent-decree, monitor, findings, settlement, status, and policy-timeline modeling
strong test of status drift and document-version normalization
lower immediate identity-harm risk than national officer lookup
scope_in: DOJ SLS law-enforcement agency matters page
acquisition protocol for linked findings, complaints, decrees, agreements, closing letters, compliance reports, and monitor-related documents
scope_out: lawsuit merits coding beyond document existence
automated claims that a department currently remains under enforcement without current status recheck
gates_before_claim_extraction: document type and effective date extracted
status label separated into source-page status and current-status candidate
privacy review for names embedded in documents
right-of-reply/correction route designed for agency-level pages
rollback path for DOJ page changes, docket changes, and monitor-page changes
rev0004_note: Pilot remains selected; rev0004 deepens it with matter objects and document-label census while keeping person extraction closed.
